info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Ticket Refunds Management API facilitates the retrieval of ticket refund information for events. It allows clients to access detailed data regarding refunds associated with purchased tickets, empowering event organizers and ticketing services to effectively manage refund requests. Typical consumers of this API include event managers and ticketing platforms aiming to streamline their refund processes and enhance customer service. This API ensures that users can efficiently track and respond to refund inquiries while maintaining clarity and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about ticket refunds, including eligibility, refund status, and amount. It is intended to assist users in understanding their refund options and current status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund process for a ticket. It requires the necessary details for processing the refund successfully.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsRefundsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for refund operations related to tickets.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsRefundsRespons.title: Refund Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the refund request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refund request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the refund operation.

audit.description: Details related to the audit log of the refund operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsRefundsRespons.description: The schema representing the response returned by the refund operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the refund request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the refund request was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the refund request was processed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing the audit log details for the refund operation.
